icons.name: overview
icons.prompt: Reinterpret the supplied MONO style board into ONE finished flat raster interface icon for Codex Lens. Single icon, not a sheet. Match the mature rounded solid charcoal silhouette, compact optical mass, subtly softened geometry and carefully carved functional negative space. Uniform #202020 ink on a CLEAN PURE WHITE #FFFFFF background for later asset extraction. Absolutely no checkerboard, gray background, shadow, glow, gradient, texture, 3D, cartoon face, eyes, decorative glints or labels. Not a thin generic system-symbol outline. Center the entire silhouette optically on a square 1024 canvas with at least 150 px whitespace on every edge, approximately 720 px active-area maximum; no part touching edges. Readable at 16–24 px with generous openings. Specific subject: HOME / OVERVIEW: a compact filled house with softly rounded roof shoulders and a simple open doorway cut out from its bottom. No windows.
